% Shared table styling. \input after xcolor (loaded with the [table] option) so every
% table in every edition gets the same treatment without editing a single generator --
% scripts/verify_tables.py enforces byte-for-byte reproduction of tables/*.tex, so the
% styling has to live here rather than in the generated files.
%
% Zebra banding starts at the first body row: booktabs supplies the rules, the band
% supplies the row tracking, and the two together let a reader follow a long row across
% many numeric columns without a vertical rule. The tint is the palette's own grid
% colour, so tables and figures sit in the same visual family.
\newcommand{\sprsTableBand}{\rowcolors{2}{}{spGrid!45}}
% Apply to every tabular without touching the tables themselves.
\let\sprsOldTabular\tabular
\renewcommand{\tabular}{\sprsTableBand\sprsOldTabular}
% Numbers in columns should line up; booktabs cannot do that on its own.
\newcommand{\sprsTabularFigures}{\addfontfeatures{}}
